source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιοι Λάζαρος και Αθανάσιος εκ Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: The life page, https://www.saint.gr/1246/saint.aspx, has its own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» of 8 Μαρτίου and «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή», and carries both men; the day's line names Athanasius second and the page heads him first. Of him it says: «Ο Ηγούμενος Αθανάσιος αγωνίστηκε στο μοναστήρι του Οσίου Λαζάρου του Μουρόμ (ή Μούρμανσκ) στα μέσα του 15ου μ.Χ. αιώνα. Δυστυχώς, δεν υπάρχουν πληροφορίες για τη ζωή του.» — unhappily there is no information about his life. It adds that after his repose his body was placed in a chapel of its own and his chains are kept there as evidence of his struggles; that he is venerated locally at Lazarus's monastery together with him; that the veneration is old, and that in the second half of the 17th century the abbot Athanasius is described as «σεβάσμιος θαυματουργός», a venerable wonderworker; that a troparion and a kontakion in his honour are known to exist, neither of which the page prints; and it describes his iconography, the prayer-rope in the left hand and in the right a scroll reading «Άκου, αδελφέ μου, και μην αμαρτάνεις μέχρι το τέλος του αιώνα», and an icon of the two men at the Dormition monastery of Murom in which they stand at full length praying to the Saviour in heaven. The «μέσα του 15ου αιώνα» is a floruit and not a year of birth or of death, so no dates object is written from it.
